name: 左文右圖輪播＋疊角小圖
desc: 左側垂直置中的文字欄，右側大圖片輪播，左下角疊著一張超出邊緣的小圖片。
prompt: 建立一個高度依內容而定的區塊。左右兩欄，內容對齊頁面內容寬度：左側約四成放文字，右側約六成放一張橫式的大圖片輪播。左側文字欄相對大圖片垂直置中、文字靠左，包含標題（可多行），上方可放小標籤，下方可放說明文字與按鈕，沒有時省略。輪播會自動切換：大圖片右下角有一個圓形計數器，中間顯示目前是第幾張，外圈是進度環，會隨該張的停留時間逐漸畫滿，畫滿後切到下一張；大圖片下緣置中有一排分頁點，目前那一張的點拉長變寬，其他維持圓點，每個點都可以點擊切換到對應的那張。大圖片的左下角疊著一張明顯較小的方形圖片，在大圖片前面，大半超出大圖片的左緣、少許超出下緣，伸進文字欄下方的空白。大圖片左上方可疊放一個小標籤，沒有時省略。
mobile: 左右兩欄改為直向堆疊：大圖片輪播在上，接近頁面內容寬度，文字在下並改為置中對齊，按鈕置中。疊在左下角的小圖片隱藏；左上方的小標籤改為跨在圖片上緣，和圖片部分重疊。分頁點與圓形進度計數器保留。

en.name: Text left + image slideshow right with overlapping thumbnail
en.desc: A vertically centered text column on the left, a large image slideshow on the right, and a small image overlapping and extending past its bottom-left corner.
en.prompt: Create a section whose height is determined by its content. Two columns aligned with the page content width: text takes about four tenths on the left, and a large landscape image slideshow takes about six tenths on the right. The left text column is vertically centered relative to the large image, with text aligned left; it contains a title (may wrap to multiple lines), optionally with a label above and a description and button below; omit them when there is no content. The slideshow advances automatically: in the bottom-right corner of the large image is a circular counter showing the current slide number, ringed by a progress ring that gradually fills over the time each slide is shown and switches to the next slide once full; a row of pagination dots sits centered along the bottom edge of the large image, where the current slide's dot stretches wider while the others stay round, and each dot can be clicked to switch to its slide. A clearly smaller square image overlaps the bottom-left corner of the large image, in front of it, extending mostly past the large image's left edge and slightly past its bottom edge into the empty space below the text column. Optionally overlay a small label on the top-left of the large image; omit it when there is no content.
en.mobile: The two columns stack vertically: the large image slideshow on top, nearly the page content width, and the text below, now center-aligned with the button centered. The small image overlapping the bottom-left corner is hidden; the small label at the top-left now straddles the top edge of the image, partly overlapping it. The pagination dots and circular progress counter are kept.
